# Churchill Downs News Release and Stakes Advances: Sycamore Winner Lambeth Shortens Up for $300,000 River City; Baffert's Multiple Stakes Winner Greenwich Village Returns to Dirt for $300,000 Bet On Sunshine


## Nov 01, 2026


Carl R. Moore Management’s Grade II Sycamore winner Lambeth leads an accomplished field of eight turf specialists entered in the 47th running of the $300,000 River City (Grade III), part of a stakes doubleheader on Saturday’s 11-race card at Churchill Downs.


Contested at 1 1/8 miles over the Matt Winn Turf Course, the River City goes as Race 8 at 4:25 p.m. (all times Eastern). The afternoon also includes the $300,000 Bet On Sunshine in Race 10 at 5:25 p.m. First post is 1 p.m.


Trained by Joe Sharp, Lambeth will cut back in distance following a one-length victory in last month’s 1 ½-mile Sycamore at Keeneland. In his previous start, Lambeth finished second to Tawny Port in the $750,000 Bowling Green Gold Cup Invitational over the extended 2 1/16 miles on turf at Kentucky Downs. The 5-year-old son of Arrogate has won six of 21 starts and earned $906,377. He will break from post No. 4 with Jose Ortiz aboard.


Other notable entrants include Flying P Stable’s Bowling Green (GII) winner Ole Crazy Bone and Bernard Baruch Stakes winner Kupuna; Don Alberto Stable’s multiple South American Group I winner Teao (CHI); and Carl Pollard’s millionaire homebred Mercante, who dead-heated for third in last year’s River City.


The field for the River City from the rail out (with jockey and trainer):


Carcano (Jaime Torres, Vicki Oliver)
Mercante (Walter Rodriguez, Brian Knippenberg)
Vote No (Umberto Rispoli, Kelsey Danner)
Lambeth (Ortiz, Sharp)
Kupuna (Francisco Arrieta, Norm Casse)
Teao (CHI) (Luis Saez, John Sadler)
Plensa (Axel Concepcion, Rusty Arnold II)
Ole Crazy Bone (Tyler Gaffalione, Mike Maker)
Fans can watch and wager on all the action from Churchill Downs on www.TwinSpires.com, the official wagering provider of Churchill Downs Incorporated.


For tickets and the latest information on the Fall Meet, please visit www.churchilldowns.com.


MULTIPLE STAKES WINNER GREENWICH VILLAGE RETURNS TO DIRT FOR $300,000 BET ON SUNSHINE – Two-time stakes winner Greenwich Village from the barn of Hall of Fame trainer Bob Baffert will return to dirt following a six-month layoff when he faces 12 rivals entered in Saturday’s 18th running of the $300,000 Bet On Sunshine at Churchill Downs.


Owned by the consortium of SF Racing, Starlight Racing, Madaket Stables, Stonestreet Stables, Bashor Racing, Determined Stables, Golconda Stable, Waves Edge Capital and Catherine Donovan, Greenwich Village won the Baffle Stakes and Pasadena Stakes on turf last winter at Santa Anita.


Following a 10th-place finish in the American Turf (GI) on Kentucky Derby Day, Greenwich Village went to the sidelines but has been working consistently at Churchill Downs since late August, including a sharp three-furlong move in :34.80 Sunday. Jockey Jose Ortiz will ride from post No. 8.


Other accomplished entrants include Alex and JoAnn Lieblong’s Viking, winner of the July 4 Smile Sprint (Listed) at Gulfstream Park; Craig Peerenboom’s Echo Again and Randy Patterson, Sam Vogel and Joe Morgan’s Dreaminblue, the second- and third-place finishers, respectively, in the Louisville Thoroughbred Society; and Leland Ackerley Racing, James Sherwood, Jode Shupe and John Cilia’s three-time stakes winner Obliteration.


The complete lineup for the Bet On Sunshine from the rail out (with jockey and trainer):


Golden Afternoon (Umberto Rispoli, Nic Vaccarezza)
Tejano Twist (Francisco Arrieta, Chris Hartman)
Viking (Tyler Gaffalione, David Fawkes)
C K Wonder (Martin, Dale Romans)
Lips Say Bliss (Cristian Torres, Robbie Medina)
Echo Again (Jaime Torres, Jordan Blair)
Obliteration (Luis Saez, Steve Asmussen)
Greenwich Village (Ortiz, Baffert)
Dreaminblue (Rafael Bejarano, Randy Morse)
Jimmy Rules (Walter Rodriguez, Susan Anderson)
Tap Me a Song (Manny Esquivel, Carlos Santamaria)
Yo Banana Boy (Gerardo Corrales, Mike Maker)
Jack’s Promise (Brian Hernandez Jr., Dale Romans)
Contested at six furlongs, the Bet On Sunshine goes as Race 10 at 5:25 p.m.


DOWN THE STRETCH – Live racing resumed Sunday at Churchill Downs for a nine-race card that began at 1 p.m. There was a $12,650 carryover in the 20-cent Derby City 6 Jackpot that began in Race 4 and a $4,990 carryover in the $1 Super Hi 5 in Race 1. … Following dark days Monday and Tuesday, live racing resumes Wednesday for Senior Day, where guests 60 and older can enjoy lunch on Millionaires’ Row for $50. For tickets and more information, call (502) 636-4450. … Next Sunday is Military Appreciation Day presented by Coca-Cola. Active-duty military or retired veterans will receive free general admission with their Military ID or can receive discounted tickets on Millionaires’ Row for $45 through their GOVX account. … For the latest information about the Churchill Downs Fall Meet, please visit www.churchilldowns.com.
